provider: LeanData UK realtime US equities SIP WebSocket
evidence: LeanData's official realtime subscription docs state that live U.S. equities trades, quotes and minute bars come from the consolidated SIP feed.

The documented stock trade frame includes symbol, price, size, event timestamp, exchange, conditions and tape; the quote frame separately includes bid/ask exchanges, prices, sizes, event timestamp, conditions and tape. Example Nasdaq-listed AAPL frames carry tape C.
The service exposes a scheduler-callable authenticated WebSocket stock channel with separate trades and quotes subscriptions, making A/B/D technically strong subject to same-run RTH validation.
The current plan matrix explicitly lists Free as 'Free (30 days)' with all WebSocket channels. The permanent plans with live WebSocket access are paid (Value/Standard/Premium).

Because XRAY requires permanent-$0 entitlement with no trial/expiry/subscription condition, a 30-day free period cannot satisfy strict gate C even if the feed is consolidated SIP and technically exact.
Legacy Basic is closed to new registration and REST-only, so it cannot be used as a permanent free live-WebSocket workaround.
reopen_condition: Official LeanData plan must provide the same consolidated-SIP realtime stock trade+quote WebSocket entitlement permanently at $0, without expiry/trial/subscription/balance/funding/activity/per-query/account-maintenance conditions; then perform same-run RTH freshness/skew validation.
